lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima distributed in a non-uniform grid across the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible across the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: A significantly higher spatial density of small high-luminance spots is observed on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin compared to the lateral flank.
